map.选择调光曲线类型，输入 DMX 值（0–255）或 0–100% 信号，计算对应: Choose a dimming curve type and enter a DMX value (0–255) or a 0–100% signal to compute the actual output brightness, for light fades and dimmer programming reference.
map.白炽灯/卤素灯调光宜用平方律（Square Law），使人眼感知亮度接近线性，避: For incandescent/halogen dimming, square law is preferable so perceived brightness is nearly linear, avoiding "jumps" in the low end.
map.需要柔和的暗部与亮部过渡时选用 S 曲线，常用于渐变与呼吸效果编程。: Use the S-curve when you need soft shadow-to-highlight transitions; it is common in fade and breathing-effect programming.
map.对比同一 DMX 值在不同曲线下的输出，在调光台编程前预判亮度曲线，统一多灯观感: Compare the output of the same DMX value under different curves to predict the brightness curve before programming the dimmer, unifying the look across multiple fixtures.
map.算例：DMX 128 在平方律曲线下: Worked example: DMX 128 under the square-law curve
map.：DMX 输入 128（约 50.2%）。平方律输出 = (128/255)²: : DMX input 128 (about 50.2%). Square-law output = (128/255)² × 255 ≈ 64.3 / 255 (about 25.2%), a brightness gain of about 0.50×; for the same input the linear curve gives 128.0 (50.2%), the S-curve about 128.2 (50.3%), and the exponential curve about 45.5 (17.9%). The curve type strongly affects the low end, and square law is closer to human perception.

map.为什么 DMX 线性曲线看起来不均匀？: Why does the DMX linear curve look uneven?
map.人眼对亮度的感知接近幂律，线性映射会让低区偏暗、高区偏亮；平方律/对数曲线更贴近: Human perception of brightness is close to a power law, so a linear mapping makes the low end too dark and the high end too bright; square-law and logarithmic curves are closer to vision.
map.不同灯具必须统一曲线吗？: Must different luminaires share one curve?
map.同场景混用曲线会导致渐变不一致；建议同批次灯具统一曲线类型并做灰度校准。: Mixing curves in the same scene makes gradients inconsistent; use one curve type per luminaire batch and perform grayscale calibration.
